### Conclusion

The dual Spark+Kafka architecture enables both historical batch analysis (Spark) AND real-time risk detection (Kafka). In this case, the reliance on Kafka for processing the single transaction allows for immediate identification of high-risk activities, while Spark could be utilized for analyzing historical trends and patterns in future transactions.
